drive_id: # Zoom meeting recordings (audio only) that a committee page lists and plays: today the Technology Committee page (/committees/technology/#recordings). One row per .m4a file in the Area's Google Drive folder MSCA09AA/Zoom Recordings/. Only the audio is ever listed: never the video, transcript or chat.

# Kept up to date by scripts/recordings.py (npm run drive:recordings, on a computer with Google Drive for Desktop): it adds new files, fills empty cells and never changes a filled cell or deletes a row. A row can also be added by hand: the file's Drive id (the long code in its Share link), committee, series, date and show.

# drive_id = the file's Drive id | committee = slug in committees.csv of the page that lists it | series = key in recording-series.csv (the meeting: its name, filter button and link) | date = YYYY-MM-DD | time = when the recording started, HH:MM (24-hour, Pacific) | part / session = Zoom's Part N / Session N, else empty | track = main (the meeting's own audio) / es (Spanish interpretation) / en (English interpretation)

# duration = H:MM:SS | size_mb = the file's size in MB (near 100 MB or more, Google Drive first asks to press Play anyway: the page says so) | show = yes / no (no keeps the recording off the site without deleting the row) | title_en / title_es = an optional name instead of the meeting's | path = where the file is, below Zoom Recordings/ | notes = for editors (not shown)
